integrity: The self-contained executable enumerates cycles and cuts and checks complete length-one, length-two and length-three factor coverage; independently established structural reduction extends coverage to every longer factor.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite classification for a labeled three-letter alphabet and de Bruijn order three only; claims rely on an exhaustive C++17 enumeration rather than extension to higher orders. A prior unindexed exhaustive census remains a priority risk.
title: Exact attractor dichotomy for ternary order-three de Bruijn unfoldings
